record.title: Resting — one part sits on another under gravity or under a preload it does not itself provide
record.why: Measured: the cell's Ø20.00 rim lands on the door's inner R92 dome at z=0.842, with zero shared volume. It is a WEAK hold on purpose and is named as one — nothing about this joint retains the cell; the three sprung contacts and the door's own bayonet do. Seating the cell on a smaller contact circle (Ø19.60) put 0.134433 mm3 of cell inside the door and ce-cad's interference check measured it, which is how the seat diameter came to be the cell's own.
record.adds_parts_why: this joint consumes no part; it joins two. No fastener, and deliberately so — a screw would cost 1.5-2.5 mm of a 7.98 mm budget and put metal inside Apple's Ø37.31 antenna keep-out (DECISIONS.md D13).
